bkra shis sangs rgyas kyi zhal gsung ni/phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs ra

tei:div.tei:p: "_ bkra shis sangs rgyas kyi zhal gsung ni/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*// snyan grags nam mkha' lta bur khyab gyur pa'i// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bdud bzhi las rgyal rgyal ba'i phrin las pa// karma pa bstan bstan pa'i snying po 'di// phyogs mthar kun khyab khyab cing rgyun mi chad// rtag par rab 'phel 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /ces rol mo rgya cher bya'o// cho ga tshar gnyis par// ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal= sems can gang dag= de dag thams cad= tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal= sems can gang dag= de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /gnas skabs su yang 'gal rkyen mtha' dag zhi// mthun rkyen tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// chos bzhin spyod pa'i grogs dang lhan cig tu// bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang*// bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*// bstan 'dzin bu slob dar zhing rgyas pa yis// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog

/ces rol mo bya'o// cho ga tshar gsum par/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med// dam chos bdud rtsi ldan pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas= dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba// rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel// rtag tu dpal gnas= tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs kyis// phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te// bde legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /bstan pa'i dpal 'gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan// bstan 'dzin skyes bus sa steng yongs la khyab// bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor pa rgyas// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces dge legs su bya zhing rol mo bya'o//
